findings.title: CVE-2023-3452: Canto WordPress Plugin RFI/RCE
findings.description: The Canto WordPress plugin (version 3.0.4) is vulnerable to Remote File Inclusion (RFI) via the 'wp_abspath' parameter in multiple PHP files including download.php. This allows unauthenticated attackers to include and execute arbitrary remote code on the server when allow_url_include is enabled in PHP configuration. The vulnerability was exploited using a data:// PHP wrapper to execute system commands.
